title: Element equation in an ideal with flat quotient
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $J\subseteq R$ an ideal. If $R/J$ is flat as an $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then for every $x\in J$ there exists $e\in J$ such that $x=xe$.
